sources.citation: Pacchiarotti, Sara, Natalia Chousou-Polydouri & Koen Bostoen. 2019. Untangling the West-Coastal Bantu mess: identification, geography and phylogeny of the Bantu B50-80 languages. Africana Linguistica 25: 155-229.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Classification/identification paper: section 'Boma and/or Buma' identifies Boma Yumu B80z as the 'Buma' of Hochegger 1972a and Burssens (S/SE of Bandundu city, Kwilu), with at least four dialects (Hochegger 1972a: III), and states its only strictly linguistic documentation is two dictionaries (Hochegger 1972a; Burssens) plus text collections; distinct language from North Boma B82 (Stappers 1986). (PDF text layer is font-shifted; rough decode.)
